techParks.name: L&T Tech Park
techParks.description: L&T Realty's IT park on Bellary Road at Byatarayanapura, north of Hebbal: Phase 1 is operational (LTIMindtree's 'S2' campus) and Phase 2 is under construction per OSM.

techParks.name: Kirloskar Business Park
techParks.description: Mid-rise business park on Bellary Road beside the Hebbal flyover, developed on Kirloskar group land. OSM maps the park (way/265565391) and a Mahindra Comviva POI inside it; Comviva's current address list does not include it. The lens brief's guesses of Rolls-Royce, Dell, Siemens and Volvo here could not be substantiated: Rolls-Royce's own site places its Bengaluru centre at Manyata, and no source was reached for the others.

techParks.name: DivyaSree Towers
techParks.description: DivyaSree office building at 55 Bannerghatta Main Road; OSM shows Convergys (now Concentrix), CSG, WinWire and V2Soft nodes around it and Cleartrip and Valtech just south, none confirmed from a company source, so no tenants are asserted.

techParks.name: Diamond District
techParks.description: Mixed-use complex on HAL Old Airport Road whose commercial towers (A, B, ...) house fintech and SaaS tenants; One Sigma Technologies (Simpl) lists Tower B and an OSM POI places Zeta here. Coordinates and bbox are the OSM commercial-block polygon.

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: KIADB's export-promotion industrial estate between Kundalahalli and ITPL; the plot-numbered campuses of Qualcomm (Plot 24, Block 1), AMD (Plot 102-103) and Microchip (Plot 149-B) make it the oldest chip-design cluster in Whitefield.

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopolis
notableTenants: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands (Madura Fashion & Lifestyle)
techParks.description: DivyaSree Developers' office campus on Old Airport Road at Yemalur (near its 77 East and 77 Town Centre projects); Sprinklr's Bengaluru office is the 3rd-floor East Wing. The point is a geocode of the adjacent DivyaSree 77 East, so treat it as approximate.

techParks.name: Aurbis Business Park
techParks.description: Office building on the ORR at Devarabeesanahalli, west of Embassy TechVillage; OSM maps an eBay office inside it.

techParks.name: Prestige Shantiniketan
techParks.description: Prestige Group's 105-acre township in Whitefield whose business precinct holds about 3.2 million sq ft across seven towers, six of them in one crescent-shaped building (Crescent 1 and 2 are ExxonMobil's) and Tower C beside the Nexus mall.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: The 1994 India-Singapore joint-venture park (KIADB/Ascendas, now CapitaLand-managed) with buildings named Discoverer, Innovator, Creator, Explorer, Inventor, Navigator, Voyager, Aviator, Pioneer, Victor and Anchor; ExxonMobil leased seven floors of Inventor in July 2026.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.description: Embassy's 3.4 msf park off the Intermediate Ring Road; Dell's India corporate office is the Crystal Downs building.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's Outer Ring Road campus (its SEZ half is registered as Pritech Park SEZ), acquired by Brookfield India REIT in 2021; Chevron's 312,000 sq ft ENGINE centre opened here in October 2025 and Optum's largest Bengaluru site is Campus 5B.

techParks.name: Divyasree 77 Town Centre
techParks.description: DivyaSree's mixed-use office campus at Yemalur between the Outer Ring Road and the airport road; OpenStreetMap records Deloitte and Thomson Reuters offices inside it (unconfirmed elsewhere).

companies.name: Larsen & Toubro
companies.description: India's largest engineering and construction conglomerate (parent of LTIMindtree and LTTS). In Bengaluru it owns the 65-acre L&T campus on Bellary Road at Byatarayanapura (home to L&T Realty's Tech Park and group companies) and keeps state offices for its infrastructure (L&T Construction) and Precision Engineering & Systems verticals; its Strategic Electronics Centre and the new L&T Electronic Products & Systems vertical (announced April 2026) are also Bengaluru-based.

Coordinates are the OSM L&T Tech Park Phase 1 polygon, not a specific L&T Ltd building.

coverageNotes: X04 gap-fill: 18 of the 20 named companies placed with 30 offices; 2 left out. LEFT OUT: (1) Atos / Eviden - Atos's own worldwide-locations page lists only Mumbai (Supremus, Kanjurmarg) and Pune (Baner) for India, with no Bengaluru office; Eviden IT Services Pvt Ltd (ex-XBS IT Services) was incorporated in Karnataka in 2015 but its registered office is now Mumbai, and no current Bengaluru delivery centre could be confirmed. (2) Netcracker Technology - its contact page lists only the Waltham HQ and its careers page mentions India staff without a city; no Bengaluru R&D address could be substantiated before the shared web-search budget ran out. NOT PLACED within a placed company: NielsenIQ (NIQ) is a separate company from Nielsen since 2021 and no NIQ Bengaluru address was found, so only Nielsen (media) is recorded. For L&T, the Strategic Electronics Centre (L&T Precision Engineering & Systems) and the new L&T Electronic Products & Systems vertical (announced 24 Apr 2026) are both Bengaluru-based, but no source gave their site.
